title: Allow building docs with a local sphinx_airflow_theme checkout
body:
closes: #45576

As titled, this PR adds an option to mount `airflow-site/sphinx_airflow_theme` when running CI locally.

<details><summary>AI Summary</summary>
Changes to the docs theme live in `airflow-site`, so checking them on real Airflow documentation meant building a wheel by hand and force-installing it inside a Breeze shell. This adds `--sphinx-airflow-theme-path` to `breeze build-docs`: the given `sphinx_airflow_theme` sub-folder of an `airflow-site` checkout is mounted read-only into the docs container and installed there before the build, so neither checkout nor `uv.lock` changes. The theme builds with `flit_core`, which does not write into the source folder, so the read-only mount is enough. Only the theme is reinstalled; a dependency the theme adds is installed with it.

```bash
breeze build-docs apache-airflow --sphinx-airflow-theme-path ../airflow-site/sphinx_airflow_theme
```

The option fails with a usage error before any Docker work when the folder has no generated CSS/JS (`./site.sh prepare-theme` not run, or the `airflow-site` root passed instead of the sub-folder), since the docs would otherwise build without styles. It also fails when combined with `--sdk-docs-only`, because the SDK docs do not use the Sphinx theme.

Verified locally with Docker: a marker added to the local theme's `layout.html` appears in the built HTML and is absent without the option. The install command was also checked against a read-only copy of the theme in the CI image. The Breeze tests for `build-docs` now share one Docker-free fixture that points `AIRFLOW_ROOT_PATH` to a temporary folder; before, the existing Python-version test deleted the real `generated/**/apis` folders. The companion `airflow-site` change adds `./site.sh build-airflow-docs` and an informational CI preview on top of this option.

Not included: `--autobuild` with automatic rebuild when the mounted theme files change (raised on #70139); tracked in #75374.
</details>

 Will build ``fab`` provider documentation and clean build artifacts before.
 
+To try a change to the HTML theme (``sphinx_airflow_theme`` from the
+`airflow-site <https://github.com/apache/airflow-site>`_ repository) on real documentation, build with the
+theme folder of an ``airflow-site`` checkout instead of the published wheel:
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+
+    breeze build-docs apache-airflow --sphinx-airflow-theme-path ../airflow-site/sphinx_airflow_theme
+
+Run ``./site.sh prepare-theme`` in ``airflow-site`` first to generate the theme's CSS/JS. Breeze mounts the
+folder read-only and installs the theme in the container before the build.
+
